why_it_matters.text: A skin medicine sold as Finacea and Skinoren, used for rosacea and acne. It occurs naturally in wheat, rye and barley, and at lower strength in skincare.

approval.basis: Marketed today (prescription) under NDA 020428 in the Drugs@FDA data files.
